column1: # index_exclusions.tsv — deliberate omissions from the ViralScan reference panel.
# Every accession in src/viralscan/data/virus_catalog.tsv declares a reference
# ViralScan claims to quantify against. A catalogued accession that never reaches
# the index is UNDETECTABLE: no read threshold recovers a read with no k-mer in
# the index. scripts/build_bundled_panel_ref.py reconciles the two on every
# build and writes the misses to catalogued_not_indexed.tsv (PLAN CAT-31,
# finding F-015).
# This file is how a miss is declared INTENTIONAL instead of UNEXPLAINED. One row
# per accession, no version suffix (matching is on the version-stripped base
# accession, so `NC_000883.2` and `NC 000883.2` are the same row):
#   accession   base accession as written in virus_catalog.tsv
#   reason      why the genome is deliberately not indexed
#   decided_by  person and date who accepted that loss of sensitivity
# Rules for editing this file:
#   * `reason` and `decided_by` are both mandatory. An exclusion with nobody's
#     name against it is not a decision, it is the original bug wearing a label.
#   * Do not add a row to silence a report. Only add one when a named reviewer has
#     accepted the coverage loss — e.g. a record that is segment-only, carries no
#     CDS, or duplicates a genome already in the panel under another accession.
#   * An entry becomes stale the moment the panel indexes that accession anyway;
#     the build reports stale entries and they should be deleted, not kept.
#   * Prefer fixing the panel over excluding an accession. CAT-32 (EBV type 2)
#     and CAT-33 (HPV breadth) are gaps of this kind, and the reason column
#     should never be used to defer them indefinitely.
# Currently empty, deliberately. As of 2026-09-27 a build of this repository
# misses 34 catalogued accessions — 13 Papillomaviridae (incl. HPV18 and HPV31),
# all 5 Retroviridae (incl. HIV-1 and HIV-2), 7 influenza D segments, 4
# coronaviruses, 3 polyomaviruses, and one each of Parvoviridae and
# Pneumoviridae. None of those is a documented exclusion: they are measured
# sensitivity gaps recorded in F-015, and pre-allowlisting them would turn a red
# build green without a genome being added. Each needs either an index entry or
# a decision by the person who owns the panel.
accession
